brit.executive_summary: Brit Insurance operates a dedicated Energy division spanning upstream, downstream, renewables and power as a core Lloyd's specialty segment on Syndicate 2987. Renewable and power covers target physical assets with incidental non-firm exposure; product pages emphasise property damage and machinery breakdown. Energy covers are conventional all-risks PD, machinery breakdown and BI without published parametric or grid-availability triggers. Brit cites data-driven underwriting on energy risks and disclosed AM Best A+ FSR supports capital. Dedicated Energy underwriting leads provide recognised North Sea and international capability. Exposure and most prep lines remain assessed-only.

axis_rationale.exposure: Above-median exposure reflects a material Lloyd's energy franchise. Book_concentration at 3 captures Energy as a core Syndicate 2987 franchise alongside property and casualty. Non_firm_intensity at 1 with predominantly firm-asset portfolio. Aggregation_correlation at 2 on UK and North Sea renewable weather clustering. Trigger_gap at 3—conventional all-risks PD and BI without parametric grid triggers, creating LMA BI mismatch on curtailment losses. Tenor_mismatch at 2 on multi-year renewable construction.
axis_rationale.preparedness: Preparation is moderate with specialist talent and capital offset by product gaps. Underwriting_expertise at 3 on dedicated Energy team with North Sea track record. Disclosed AM Best A+ FSR anchors capital_reinsurance at 4. Data_monitoring and pricing_modelling at 3 reflect cited data-driven underwriting without published curtailment models. Product_fit at 1—traditional property, BI and liability without parametric availability wordings for grid output.
